title: Étale restriction pullback unit equality for fixed base-change étale structure
statement: With the same hypotheses and notation as lem-weil-pbc-etale-restriction-pullback-unit, for a specified Etale p' structure hp', the displayed equality of homomorphisms in that theorem holds.

source.place: agent split of the unit compatibility proof, isolating the equality after étaleness of p' is supplied

proof.text: Apply the unit equation for the uniqueness-of-left-adjoint restriction comparison. Naturality at a morphism psi:c -> pullback(f)(b) identifies the unit followed by restriction and rho_f(c) with F applied to the adjoint transpose of psi. This is the private proved helper restriction_unit; at the two diagonal maps it gives hδ and hσ, including the terminal-object isomorphisms eW and eW'.

Evaluate Etale.upperStarComp_hom_app_unit_app at an étale object b and restrict along psi into the pullback along the composite. Naturality of the composition comparison gives the private proved helper composition_unit. Construct gamma=(g',id) over wx, delta=(id,id) over wx, and sigma=(id,id) over wy'. The two identities hχq and hχj with the pullback-pasting maps follow by extensionality on each projection, using hι₁ and hι₂.

Apply composition_unit to (g',p) and (p',g), with common composite g' ≫ p and equality hcomm for the second pair. Rewrite the pasting identities and use naturality of the units, then hδ and hσ. The resulting equalities hq and hj express the two routes in terms of the same restricted composite unit. Cancel the first composition isomorphism and compare with the second. Precompose by rhoF and F(eW.inv), postcompose by rhoG and gF(eW'.inv), and cancel the four inverse pairs to obtain the stated equality.

lean.statement: theorem etale_restriction_pullback_unit_eq {X Y W W' : Scheme.{u}} (g : Y ⟶ X) (p : W ⟶ X) (g' : W' ⟶ W) (p' : W' ⟶ Y) (hcomm : g' ≫ p = p' ≫ g) (ι : W' ⟶ pullback p g) (hι₁ : ι ≫ pullback.fst p g = g') (hι₂ : ι ≫ pullback.snd p g = p') [IsIso ι] [hp : Etale p] (hp' : Etale p') : let A := AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1} let w : W.Etale := Scheme.Etale.mk (𝟙 W) let w' : W'.Etale := Scheme.Etale.mk (𝟙 W') let wx : X.Etale := Scheme.Etale.mk p let wy' : Y.Etale := @Scheme.Etale.mk _ _ p' hp' let eW : (MorphismProperty.Over.map ⊤ hp).obj w ≅ wx := MorphismProperty.Over.isoMk (Iso.refl W) (by simp [wx, w]) let eW' : (MorphismProperty.Over.map ⊤ hp').obj w' ≅ wy' := MorphismProperty.Over.isoMk (Iso.refl W') (by simp [wy', w']) let theta : w' ⟶ (MorphismProperty.Over.pullback @Etale ⊤ g').obj w := MorphismProperty.Over.homMk (pullback.lift g' (𝟙 W') (by exact (Category.comp_id g').trans (Category.id_comp g').symm)) (by simp [w']) let iotaSite : wy' ⟶ (MorphismProperty.Over.pullback @Etale ⊤ g).obj wx := MorphismProperty.Over.homMk ι hι₂ ∀ F : Sheaf X.smallEtaleTopology A, let pF := (Etale.upperStar A p).obj F let gF := (Etale.upperStar A g).obj F let K := (Etale.upperStar A g').obj pF let rhoF := (Etale.upperStarIsoLocalizationRestriction A p hp).hom.app F let rhoG := (Etale.upperStarIsoLocalizationRestriction A p' hp').hom.app gF let kappa := (Etale.upperStarComp A g' p).inv.app F ≫ (Etale.upperStarComp A p' g (g' ≫ p) hcomm).hom.app F ((Etale.upperStarLowerStarAdjunction A g').unit.app pF).hom.app (op w) ≫ K.obj.map theta.op ≫ kappa.hom.app (op w') ≫ rhoG.hom.app (op w') ≫ gF.obj.map eW'.inv.op = rhoF.hom.app (op w) ≫ F.obj.map eW.inv.op ≫ ((Etale.upperStarLowerStarAdjunction A g).unit.app F).hom.app (op wx) ≫ gF.obj.map iotaSite.op

blueprint_update.statement:
Let
$$\begin{array}{ccc}W'&\xrightarrow{\;g'\;}&W\\ {\scriptstyle p'}\big\downarrow&&\big\downarrow{\scriptstyle p}\\ Y&\xrightarrow{\;g\;}&X\end{array}$$
be a commutative square of schemes with $p$ étale such that the induced morphism $\iota=(g',p'):W'\to W\times_XY$ is an isomorphism (so $p'$ is étale as well). Regard $(W,p)$ as an object of $X_{\Et}$ and $(W',p')$ as an object of $Y_{\Et}$ [def-weil-pbc-etale-site]. Let $F$ be an abelian sheaf on $X_{\Et}$, let $\rho_F:p^{-1}F\xrightarrow{\sim}F|_W$ and $\rho_{g^{-1}F}:p'^{-1}g^{-1}F\xrightarrow{\sim}(g^{-1}F)|_{W'}$ be the isomorphisms of [lem-weil-pbc-etale-inverse-image-restriction], let $\eta_g$ and $\eta_{g'}$ be the units of the adjunctions $g^{-1}\dashv g_*$ and $g'^{-1}\dashv g'_*$ [def-weil-pbc-inverse-image], [def-weil-pbc-direct-image], and let $\kappa:g'^{-1}p^{-1}F\cong(p g')^{-1}F=(g p')^{-1}F\cong p'^{-1}g^{-1}F$ be built from the composition isomorphisms of [lem-weil-pbc-inverse-image-composition]. Then the following two homomorphisms $\Gamma(W,p^{-1}F)\to(g^{-1}F)(W'\xrightarrow{p'}Y)$ are equal:

1. $\eta_{g',p^{-1}F}(W):\Gamma(W,p^{-1}F)\to(g'^{-1}p^{-1}F)(W\times_WW')$, followed by restriction along $\theta=(g',\mathrm{id}):W'\to W\times_WW'$, by $\kappa(W')$ and by $\rho_{g^{-1}F}(W')$;
2. $\rho_F(W):\Gamma(W,p^{-1}F)\to F(W\xrightarrow{p}X)$, followed by $\eta_{g,F}(W):F(W)\to(g^{-1}F)(W\times_XY)$ and by restriction along the $Y$-morphism $\iota:W'\to W\times_XY$.

In words: under the identifications $\rho$ of inverse images along étale maps with restrictions, pulling a section back along $g'$ agrees with pulling it back along $g$ and restricting along $\iota$.

proof.text: Put $h=p\circ g'=g\circ p'$. By clause (2) of [lem-weil-pbc-etale-inverse-image-restriction], under $\rho$ the unit of $p^{-1}\dashv p_*$ is restriction of sections; restricting this description along the diagonal $W\to W\times_XW$ (an open immersion, $p$ being étale) expresses $\rho_F(W)^{-1}$ as the unit $\eta_{p,F}$ at $W$ followed by restriction along the diagonal, and likewise $\rho_{g^{-1}F}(W')^{-1}\circ(\text{restriction along }\iota)$ through the unit of $p'^{-1}\dashv p'_*$ restricted along $(\iota,\mathrm{id})$. By clause (2) of [lem-weil-pbc-inverse-image-composition], the composition isomorphism $g'^{-1}p^{-1}\cong h^{-1}$ is compatible with the units: the unit of $h^{-1}\dashv h_*$ is the composite of the units for $p$ and for $g'$, followed by the composition isomorphism. Evaluating at $W$ and restricting along $W'\to W\times_XW'$, $w'\mapsto(g'(w'),w')$, identifies the homomorphism in 1, followed by the inverse of $p'^{-1}g^{-1}F\cong h^{-1}F$, with the unit of $h$ restricted to $W'$ and precomposed with $\rho_F(W)^{-1}$. The same computation for the factorization $h=g\circ p'$ identifies the homomorphism in 2, followed by the same isomorphism, with the same map. Cancelling the composition isomorphism gives the equality. Étaleness of $p'$ follows from stability of étale morphisms under base change, as $\iota$ is an isomorphism.
